label: HTTP
description: HTTP out, HTTP connections, HTTP triggers, body codecs. Settings say which codec handles which content type; a content type mapped to the blob codec is stored as a file and carried as a handle. Who may call a route is not this plugin's business: a trigger attaches its policies and gives the guard the token where the route reads it (a header, a cookie), and the guarding plugin (@wilanis/plugin-auth) identifies the caller.

host.description: the interface to listen on, for every listen step that writes no host of its own: an address of this host (127.0.0.1 on a laptop). Absent: every interface, on both address families

deadlineMs.description: the most a route's run may take, in milliseconds, from firing to answer, for every route that writes no deadlineMs of its own; past it the run is cancelled and answered 504. Absent: a route without its own has none

maxBodyBytes.description: the most a request body may weigh, for every route that writes no maxBodyBytes of its own; past it the request is answered 413 before the codec finishes. Absent: a route without its own has none

codecs.description: content type -> codec document path, e.g. "application/json": "@http/codecs/json.codec.json"
